name: BRATS On-Demand
note: Service covers Baldwin County countywide including Eastern Shore, Foley, Robertsdale, Bay Minette, and Gulf Shores areas.

name: LR Rides (Lee-Russell Public Transit On-Demand)
note: LRPT on-demand zones cover Auburn, Opelika, Lee County, and Russell County. Separate PEX Paratransit component (Phenix City/Columbus GA) is excluded.

name: MAX On-Demand (formerly Birmingham On-Demand)
note: Core coverage ~26.6 sq mi centered on Birmingham with zones in Downtown, East/Airport, North Birmingham, Mountain Brook, and pilot expansion to Homewood and Irondale.

name: MoGo Rideshare
note: Launch press materials describe a '17-mile service zone' (not further specified as radius vs. area) centered on southeastern Mobile, much smaller than the full city. Treated as ~17 sq mi (radius_km derived from area) centered on the CSV pin in southeastern Mobile, clipped to city limits. Sources: https://ridewithvia.com/news/mobile-area-chamber-of-commerce-foundation-and-via-launch-mogo-rideshare-an-on-demand-transit-pilot-to-expand-access-to-career-opportunities and https://city.ridewithvia.com/mogo (zone map image, southeastern Mobile).

name: The M: Micro Transit
note: On-demand service within Montgomery city limits with mapped zones including Downtown, Regional Airport, Whitewater, Maxwell AFB Visitor Center, and Jackson Hospital.
